about: FOIA loans (all statuses) by asset class, NAICS code and the NAICS editions the map lists the code under. A code can sit in several editions; foia_loans_by_edition_set groups by that set. Loans with a blank NaicsCode belong to no class. Before FY2001 SBA left the code blank on whole industries (see blank_naics.rows_by_fy), so class figures that include those years undercount.
